notes.title: 🎣 Gloopalaxy is joining the Fishing Fest (June 16-23) 🎣
notes.notes:
[p]What better timing than this festival to release our first fishing update!

[b]Here's what to expect:[/b][/p][list][*][p] Completely revamped space exploration interface[/p][/*][*][p]You now have to choose a fishing spot BEFORE the minigame, instead of choosing your loot at the end[/p][/*][*][p]Each fishing zone now has it's own parallax background![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This is not the final update we'll make to the fishing gameplay, as we're planning to add difficulty levels/minigame variations, and a very cool secret feature 👀. [/p][p][/p][p]We have tons of other fishing ideas we'd love to implement, but we're curious about yours! We've set up a feedback form to hear your thoughts on the game and help us improve it. [/p][p]🦀 English form: [url="https://framaforms.org/feedback-gloopalaxy-demo-1746697883"]https://framaforms.org/feedback-gloopalaxy-demo-1746697883[/url][/p][p]🦐 Formulaire français : [url="https://framaforms.org/retours-demo-gloopalaxy-1746695909"]https://framaforms.org/retours-demo-gloopalaxy-1746695909[/url][/p]
